source.section: Rules #9-#11 (PDF pp.5-7); single-dance tiebreakers Rules #6-#8 (PDF pp.3-5)
source.quote_free_summary: Multi-dance championship results combine per-dance placements into an aggregate value with head-to-head tiebreakers; single-dance ties continue through look-ahead, look-behind and head-to-head rules before a placement is shared.

requirement: Overall Multi-Dance calculation and the tiebreakers (Rules #9-#11, and #6-#8 for single dances) are NOT IMPLEMENTED for a future UCWDC engine. The Studio ordinal engine stops its tie chain earlier and shares the placement (OD-13); it is not modified to approximate them.
enforcement_point: Not built. NOT IMPLEMENTED; a blocker for activating the corresponding future governing-body profile. Studio/Custom behavior is unchanged.

tests.name: a single-dance run carries no overall, combined or aggregate field

interpretation_notes: R-07(8). Related audit rows S-08, S-16; OD-13, OD-24. Fail-closed today: a run covering several dances is refused (X-6).
